nodes.description: Constant string state variable 'name' = "xBTC" of the xbtcdefi token contract.
Constant string state variable 'symbol' = "XBTC".
Constant uint8 state variable 'decimals' = 18.
Mapping(address => uint256) holding token balances; mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
Nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) holding ERC20 allowances; mutated by approve and transferFrom.
uint256 total token supply set in the constructor to 4,000,000e18.
Constructor(uint256 total) that overwrites the total argument with 4,000,000e18 and credits msg.sender.
View function returning totalSupply_.
View function returning balances[tokenOwner].
External transfer of numTokens from msg.sender to receiver, using SafeMath sub/add and a require balance check.
External approve setting allowed[msg.sender][delegate] = numTokens without any checks.
View function returning allowed[owner][delegate].
External transferFrom moving numTokens from owner to buyer, checked against balances[owner] and allowed[owner][msg.sender].
Caller-controlled address used as balance owner, allowance spender and initial supply recipient.
SafeMath.sub arithmetic (assert(b <= a); a - b) applied to balances and allowances.
SafeMath.add arithmetic (c = a + b; assert(c >= a)) applied to recipient balances.
Ownership/allowance access-control requires in transferFrom: numTokens <= balances[owner] and numTokens <= allowed[owner][msg.sender].
Constructor parameter 'total' that is immediately overwritten by the hardcoded supply.
Parameter 'tokenOwner' of balanceOf used as mapping key.
Parameter 'receiver' of transfer, destination of the added balance.
Parameter 'numTokens' of transfer, amount subtracted/added.
Parameter 'delegate' of approve, spender key.
Parameter 'numTokens' of approve, allowance value.
Parameter 'owner' of allowance.
Parameter 'delegate' of allowance.
Parameter 'owner' of transferFrom, source of funds.
Parameter 'buyer' of transferFrom, destination of funds.
Parameter 'numTokens' of transferFrom, amount moved.

edges.reason: msg.sender receives the entire initial supply of totalSupply_ in the constructor.
msg.sender is the implicit debit address and its balance is required to cover numTokens in transfer.
msg.sender is used as the allowance owner key in approve, letting a caller set arbitrary allowances.
msg.sender is used as spender key in allowed[owner][msg.sender] in transferFrom.
Constructor parameter total is overwritten before being assigned to totalSupply_.
Constructor writes the hardcoded supply into totalSupply_.
Constructor credits balances[msg.sender] with the entire supply.
totalSupply() returns totalSupply_.
balanceOf uses tokenOwner as the balances mapping key.
balanceOf reads balances[tokenOwner].
transfer uses receiver as the destination balance key.
transfer uses numTokens as the amount to move.
transfer reads and writes balances for msg.sender and receiver.
numTokens flows into SafeMath.sub on balances[msg.sender].
transfer performs balances[msg.sender].sub(numTokens).
transfer performs balances[receiver].add(numTokens).
approve uses delegate as the spender key.
approve writes numTokens into the allowance mapping.
approve sets allowed[msg.sender][delegate] = numTokens with no sanity checks.
allowance uses owner as the outer mapping key.
allowance uses delegate as the inner mapping key.
allowance returns allowed[owner][delegate].
transferFrom uses owner as the source balance and allowance key.
transferFrom uses buyer as the destination balance key.
transferFrom uses numTokens as the amount to move.
transferFrom requires numTokens <= balances[owner] and numTokens <= allowed[owner][msg.sender] before moving funds.
transferFrom performs .sub(numTokens) on balances[owner] and allowed[owner][msg.sender].
transferFrom performs balances[buyer].add(numTokens).
numTokens flows into SafeMath.sub inside transferFrom.
transferFrom reads and decrements allowed[owner][msg.sender].
transferFrom reads and mutates balances[owner] and balances[buyer].
The allowance/ownership check gates execution of the rest of transferFrom.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter total is discarded and only serves to feed the constructor's hardcoded supply assignment.
tokenOwner is solely an input key for the balanceOf lookup.
receiver only parameterizes the credit branch of transfer.
numTokens only parameterizes the SafeMath sub/add amount in transfer.
delegate is only the spender key written by approve.
numTokens is only the allowance value written by approve.
owner is only the outer lookup key of allowance.
delegate is only the inner lookup key of allowance.
owner is only the debit source and allowance owner consumed by transferFrom.
buyer is only the credit destination consumed by transferFrom.
numTokens is the operand that drives the SafeMath sub call inside transferFrom.
